title: Testimonial
description: Customer testimonial with author information, company, position, message, rating, avatar, and featured status. Used for testimonials sections, review displays, and customer feedback showcases.

name.description: Full name of the person giving the testimonial

position.description: Job title or position of the testimonial author

company.description: Company or organization the testimonial author works for

rating.description: Rating given, typically on a scale of 1-5

avatar.description: URL to the testimonial author's photo

featured.description: Whether this testimonial is featured and should be prominently displayed

created_at.description: Timestamp when the testimonial was created
